_about: BadCode's QA checklist for Flow stills and clips, scanned with tools/qa-scanner/qa.py BEFORE anything is shown to Jack or Kai (rule: docs/rules/flow.md). Started from tools/qa-scanner/checklists/generic.json on 2026-11-25; every item past the generic ones is a fault Jack or Kai named, quoted in 'source'. Add one item for every new fault they name. 'yes' = defect. Items that start 'If…' are skipped when they don't apply; items marked 'needs --prompt' only work when the prompt is passed.

still.q: Does any person have extra or missing limbs, an extra arm or hand, a hand or glove with no body attached, fused or duplicated bodies, a melted face, or warped hands?
still.fail_if: any such fault anywhere
still.fix: re-roll; if one small figure, crop or blur it
still.source: Jack/Kai: 'an extra arm picking up the tea', 'gloves floating on the device in his mouth'

still.q: Look at every person whose feet are off the ground. Is the height plausible for a real jump, are the legs bent for take-off or landing, and is there a shadow directly below them? Is every standing or walking person's foot on the ground with a contact shadow?
still.fail_if: anyone floats
still.fix: describe feet planted and the shadow under them; regenerate from words
still.source: generic

still.q: Is there any readable text, letters, numbers, logo, crest, badge or brand mark anywhere (clothes front and back, signs, boards, screens, objects)?
still.fail_if: any mark that reads as text, a number or a logo
still.fix: describe the surface as plain and smooth; blur small marks; re-roll if large
still.source: generic

still.q: Does anyone or anything look cut out and pasted in or overlaid: wrong scale for where they stand, wrong lighting, no shadow, edges that don't sit in the scene, a logo floating over glass rather than on it?
still.fail_if: any person looks stuck on
still.fix: regenerate the whole frame from words (no edit that adds people)
still.source: generic + 'She looks slightly overlaid', 'look more like it is on the glass rather than an overlay'

still.q: Looking at the faces you can make out, is there a real mix of ethnicities, not all or nearly all one?
still.fail_if: four or more faces can be made out and all, or nearly all, are one ethnicity (Jack/Kai want a mix by default)
still.fix: describe the nearest faces one by one with heritage; give the crowd a stated mix
still.source: 'make it diverse, as in add at least one person that is not white', 'diverisfy the crowd please'

still.q: If a REFERENCE image was given, does the matching subject (place, character, product) match it?
still.fail_if: a clearly different design
still.fix: attach the reference and describe its key features; re-roll
still.source: generic

still.q: Does anything look like a real brand, logo, club, product, famous place, or a well-known existing emblem (e.g. a superhero logo)?
still.fail_if: anything recognisable
still.fix: describe it as plain and invented; re-roll
still.source: generic + Jack: 'it looks too much like the iron man logo'

still.q: Is anything else physically wrong: impossible geometry, duplicated people side by side, objects melting or merging, things hanging in the air for no reason?
still.fail_if: any such fault
still.fix: re-roll with the fault described away positively
still.source: generic

still.q: Are two people the same person twice, or do extras look like twins or clones (same face, hair and clothes)?
still.fail_if: any duplicate or twin that wasn't asked for
still.fix: describe each extra one by one (age, hair, clothes); regenerate from words
still.source: 'two maddies actually appear', 'the other two look the same'

still.q: Does any face look like a real famous person (actor, politician, celebrity)?
still.fail_if: any recognisable likeness
still.fix: make a big portrait of the character first and attach it; never name the real person; regenerate
still.source: 'thats hugh laurie, please no famous people', flow.md lookalike rule

still.q: Is any person or object the wrong size for its depth or next to the others (a giant, a tiny prop, comically large keys)?
still.fail_if: anything clearly out of scale
still.fix: state sizes against each other in the prompt; regenerate
still.source: 'Maggie is about twice as big as she should be', 'the guy in the middle is a giant', 'the keys are comically large'

still.q: Are signs, screens, buildings or flat surfaces skewed with perspective that doesn't match the camera?
still.fail_if: any surface visibly at the wrong angle
still.fix: describe the camera height and the surface facing it; regenerate
still.source: 'the downland bank looks really skewed', 'the perspective… is off'

still.q: Is the main subject's head, shoulder or a key body part cut off awkwardly by the frame edge?
still.fail_if: an unintended crop of the subject
still.fix: describe the framing with room around the subject; re-roll
still.source: 'her shoulder seems to be cut off a little bit'

still.q: Do people stand directly in front of each other, overlap or look squeezed together?
still.fail_if: the main people block or crush each other
still.fix: place each person in the frame by name with space between; regenerate
still.source: 'she stood right in front of another gang member… spread the gang members out', 'She feels squeezed in'

still.q: Does the layout make physical sense (vehicles on roads, people where they could stand, things the right way round)?
still.fail_if: a layout the brain rejects (driving on the pavement, cars on a river)
still.fix: stage the space in words: where everything is and which way it faces; regenerate, never edit a layout
still.source: 'drive into the pavement… composed in a way that makes sense to the brain', 'there are cars on the river'

still.q: If the prompt says who someone looks at or faces, are they actually looking at that person or thing (not the lens, not between two people)?
still.fail_if: the eyeline or facing is wrong (judge at full size)
still.fix: start the still already facing the target; name the one person and have them look back; regenerate
still.source: 'hes not facing the ginger man', 'facing the camera, not the people eavesdropping', 'he should look to the right not the left'

still.q: Does a background extra stare at the camera or do something that pulls the eye from the subject?
still.fail_if: an extra draws attention
still.fix: give the extras a task facing away; regenerate
still.source: 'this one old man that's facing back towards the camera. It completely throws the eye'

still.q: Is anyone or anything the prompt asks for missing (a character, a driver, a prop in a hand)?
still.fail_if: any required person or prop absent (needs --prompt)
still.fix: name the missing person or prop early in the prompt; regenerate
still.source: 'bob is not in the clip', 'there is no one in the drivers seat', 'there is no gun in his hand'

still.q: Does the number of people or objects differ from what the prompt asks for (e.g. two where one was asked)?
still.fail_if: a wrong count (needs --prompt)
still.fix: state the count and name each one; regenerate
still.source: 'two satellites appear… just with one satellite'

still.q: If anyone wears a full-face balaclava or mask: are there eye holes, or real human eyes or skin visible through it?
still.fail_if: eye holes or eyes visible (skip if no mask)
still.fix: describe the mask as seamless fabric with no openings; regenerate
still.source: 'fix the masks there are eye holes', 'there's human eyes behind the yellow bally'

still.q: If anyone wears a full-face balaclava or mask: is any skin showing (lips, neck, wrists, chest)?
still.fail_if: any skin on a masked character (skip if no mask)
still.fix: cover neck, wrists and chest in words (gloves, high collar); never write a word that bares skin; regenerate
still.source: 'we shouldnt see his lips', 'never show skin on the balaclava badcode guys', 'skin on the wrist'

still.q: If a masked character has an emblem on the mask, is it missing, on the wrong eye (it belongs over the LEFT eye) or misplaced?
still.fail_if: emblem missing or wrong place (skip if no mask)
still.fix: attach the mask reference; state the emblem's place; regenerate
still.source: 'there is no triangle over his left eye', 'the logo is in the wrong place on the balaclava'

still.q: If a REFERENCE mask or costume was given, does the mask's colour, design or material differ from it?
still.fail_if: a different mask (skip if no mask)
still.fix: attach the reference; describe nothing else about the mask; regenerate
still.source: 'the masks are wrong… should be like the ones in [reference]', 'green mask is wrong'

still.q: Has the generator drawn its own version of a logo or emblem meant to be the BadCode logo (it should be laid in during the edit)?
still.fail_if: a generated stand-in for the logo
still.fix: leave the space plain and lay the real logo file in during the edit
still.source: CLAUDE.md: the logo is fixed, never hand-edited

still.q: Is money shown in a currency other than the one the story is set in (pounds sterling for a British story)?
still.fail_if: wrong currency
still.fix: name the notes (e.g. Bank of England pound notes) without readable text; regenerate
still.source: Jack: 'the money on the tree are dollars, please make them english pound sterling'

still.q: Do TVs, monitors or phone screens look wrong (an overlay floating on them, a coloured border, odd content)?
still.fail_if: a screen looks pasted or broken
still.fix: describe the screen off or with plain light; put content in during the edit
still.source: 'there's an overlay on the TV screen', 'a red border around the black'

still.q: Is there a detail no real scene would show (a door open while driving, a machine running with its door open, a car in a bus)?
still.fail_if: any such detail
still.fix: describe the object's real state in words; regenerate
still.source: 'driving with the back door open', 'the washing machine door is open and spinning'

still.q: If the prompt names a period, is anything from the wrong era (modern cars, phones, clothes)?
still.fail_if: an anachronism (needs --prompt)
still.fix: name period-correct makes and styles; regenerate
still.source: 'it looks like a modern car please make it look like the prohabition era'

still.q: Is the main subject clearly recognisable as what it should be (Earth looks like Earth, not a red splodge or another planet)?
still.fail_if: the subject reads as something else
still.fix: describe its defining features plainly; regenerate
still.source: 'doesn't look like Earth… generic red splodge', 'it looks too much like Saturn'

still.q: Does the setting's texture fit (a war-torn road isn't tidy; a clean room has no mud)?
still.fail_if: wrong cleanliness or texture for the place
still.fix: describe the dirt or cleanliness explicitly; regenerate
still.source: 'the road is far too tidy', 'the mud on the boots, it's a clean room'

still.q: Does a face or pose show the wrong emotion or intent for the prompt (too happy, wilful when it should be accidental)?
still.fail_if: a clear mismatch (needs --prompt)
still.fix: name the expression and the reason for it; regenerate
still.source: 'the old woman shouldn't be so happy', 'it looks like she willfully throws it'

still.q: Does the frame have the generic AI look: too clean, glossy, symmetrical, staged, evenly lit, stock-photo perfect?
still.fail_if: it reads as AI slop at a glance
still.fix: follow the story's look; real-photo references, imperfect light, asymmetric staging; regenerate
still.source: 'most of the film looks like ai slop', 'looks AI like'

still.q: Does anything meant to look real look cartoony, plastic, waxy or CGI (skin, wet pavement, reflections)?
still.fail_if: any plastic or CGI surface
still.fix: describe real materials and grain; regenerate
still.source: 'far too kind of cartoony AI', 'the reflection on the pavement… plasticky'

still.q: Is the image soft, pixelated, or visibly upscaled?
still.fail_if: visible low quality
still.fix: generate at full resolution; never a low-res draft
still.source: 'you can tell the quality is low', 'the pixelation is pretty obvious'

still.q: Is there an unexplained object or extra person that distracts from the subject?
still.fail_if: a distracting extra thing
still.fix: leave it out of the prompt or name the clear space; re-roll
still.source: 'the trolley with the clothes needs to go away', 'remove the bubbles'

clip.q: Does any person, face, limb or object morph, melt, split, merge, duplicate or change identity during the clip?
clip.fix: fewer movers; keep the crowd still; re-roll
clip.source: generic + 'all the horses morph and change', 'the bottle of bleach turns into a rag', 'denise's face look weird and morphed'

clip.q: Does anything jump position between frames, appear from nowhere or vanish?
clip.fix: keep objects still or out of frame; cut on a reaction
clip.source: generic + 'the horse teleported', 'when he spins around he kind of teleports', 'cars pop in and out of frame'

clip.q: Do people's feet stay on the ground when they walk or run (no gliding, sliding or floating)?
clip.fix: slower movement, feet planted, re-roll
clip.source: generic + 'he seems to float in the air', 'Maddie slides down the hill', 'just balencing on one leg'

clip.q: Does readable text, a number, a caption or a logo appear at any point?
clip.fix: blur in the edit or re-roll
clip.source: generic + 'remove the same bench caption'

clip.q: Is the camera motion smooth and believable, without warping the scene or the people?
clip.fail_if: the set warps or the camera jerks
clip.fix: lock the camera and add the move in the edit
clip.source: generic

clip.q: Is anything else physically wrong (smoke, fire, liquids, a ball with no physics)?
clip.fix: keep it out of frame or still; re-roll
clip.source: generic

clip.q: Does an extra arm, hand or glove appear (one with no body, or more than a person has)?
clip.fix: re-roll; have the arm come from a visible person
clip.source: 'an extra arm picking up the tea'

clip.q: Does the same person appear twice, or do extras look like clones?
clip.fix: describe each person; re-roll
clip.source: 'two maddies actually appear'

clip.q: Does a body or object pass through something solid (a hand through a glass, a person through a bench)?
clip.fix: simpler action, the object out of the path; re-roll
clip.source: 'his hand goes through the glass', 'she walks through the bench'

clip.q: Does a face, outfit or accessory change, appear or vanish during the clip (a cap appears, earphones vanish, a mask disappears)?
clip.fail_if: any change in what someone wears or looks like
clip.fix: attach the character reference; fewer movers; re-roll
clip.source: 'Tarquin's earphones disappeared', 'drivers mask dissapears', 'Derek's got a cap on'

clip.q: Does any face turn into a real famous person during the clip?
clip.fix: start from a still made portrait-first; re-roll
clip.source: flow.md lookalike rule

clip.q: Does the action reset or repeat (someone does the same move twice, a loop or stutter)?
clip.fix: one action per clip; re-roll
clip.source: 'it kind of like resets… they pull it up twice'

clip.q: Does anything suddenly change direction or turn the wrong way (a vehicle reversing, a person turning mid-fall)?
clip.fix: state the direction of travel throughout; re-roll
clip.source: 'The ambulance randomly changes direction', 'he turns around mid fall'

clip.q: Does something move that should stay still (props falling, wobbling, a setting changing when only one thing should change)?
clip.fix: say what moves and that everything else stays still; re-roll
clip.source: 'make sure only the mini house moves', 'the megaphone kind of wobbles', 'the setting needs to stay the same… only the prices change'

clip.q: Is the action over the top or unrealistic (flying falls, cartoon impacts, things bursting out of walls)?
clip.fix: make it simpler and smaller; re-roll
clip.source: 'ai slop everything is so exaggerated please make it simple', 'the safe coming out the wall looks awful'

clip.q: Are gestures or head movements stiff, repetitive or odd (turning the head back and forth, a teacherly gesture, a gesture that doesn't fit the line)?
clip.fix: one specific gesture tied to the line; re-roll
clip.source: 'gestures like a geography teacher', 'turn their head and then turn their head back'

clip.q: Does the clip look like a still photo with a zoom, with nothing really moving?
clip.fix: give the subject one clear action; re-roll
clip.source: 'nothing animates. It feels like this is an image', 'a photograph just zoomed in'

clip.q: Does the motion look sped up, slow motion, or too fast for the action?
clip.fix: state real-time speed and the pace of the action; re-roll
clip.source: 'kind of like half speed', 'This clip looks speeded up'

clip.q: Is anyone or anything the wrong size for the scene at any point?
clip.fix: fix the still first, then re-animate
clip.source: 'the guy in the middle is a giant'

clip.q: Does a person look at the wrong person, or drift back to the lens, when the prompt says who they look at?
clip.fix: start the still facing the target; 'keeps his face turned towards them the whole time'
clip.source: flow.md: 'facing the camera, not the people eavesdropping'

clip.q: Does a background extra look at the camera, stand up, or do something that pulls the eye?
clip.fix: keep the extras still or out of frame; re-roll
clip.source: 'the guy closest to the camera… stands up and then sits down'

clip.q: Is anyone or anything the prompt asks for missing from the clip?
clip.fail_if: a required person or prop absent (needs --prompt)
clip.fix: fix the start still; re-roll
clip.source: 'there is no one in the drivers seat'

clip.q: Does the number of people or objects differ from the prompt, or change during the clip?
clip.fix: fewer movers; re-roll
clip.source: 'two satellites appear… just with one satellite'

clip.q: If anyone wears a full-face balaclava or mask: do eye holes, eyes, lips or skin show, does the emblem leave the left eye, or does the mask change?
clip.fail_if: any mask fault (skip if no mask)
clip.fix: fix the start still; re-roll
clip.source: 'there's human eyes behind the yellow bally', 'we shouldnt see his lips', 'should always be on the left eye'

clip.q: Does someone pull on or take off a mask in a way that looks wrong?
clip.fix: cut around it: start the clip with the mask already on
clip.source: 'it looks terrible when they put the masks on'

clip.q: Do screens in the shot flash, show an overlay or a border?
clip.fix: describe the screens as off; put content in during the edit
clip.source: 'the random tv screen flashing'

clip.q: Does anything happen that no real scene would show (a car drives into a bus, someone eats and talks at once)?
clip.fix: describe the real action; re-roll
clip.source: 'the car drives straight into the bus', 'hes eating and talking at the same time'

clip.q: If a REFERENCE (the start still or an earlier shot) was given, does the clip change the set, props, layout, light or a character's condition from it?
clip.fix: attach the reference as the start frame; re-roll
clip.source: 'this arrangement of chairs does not line up', 'we still have dirty Maddy'

clip.q: Do positions or heads jump suddenly, especially in the last second?
clip.fix: trim the tail in the edit or re-roll
clip.source: 'all of the heads just jump', 'the bus at the end of the shot jumps'

clip.q: Does the clip look like generic AI slop (glossy, staged, synthetic)?
clip.fail_if: it reads as AI at a glance
clip.fix: follow the story's look; simpler action; re-roll
clip.source: 'the clips from here on, are a bit ai slop and boring'

clip.q: Does anything meant to look real look cartoony, plastic or CGI?
clip.fix: re-roll from a more real start still
clip.source: 'far too kind of cartoony AI'

clip.q: Is the grain far too heavy, or does the colour or grade shift during the clip or look grey and washed out?
clip.fix: fix the grade in the edit; re-roll if baked in
clip.source: 'a bit too Grainy', 'a noticeable grading shift', 'a tad too grey'

clip.q: Do lights pulse, flicker or go out, or does a stray frame from another shot appear?
clip.fix: keep light sources steady in the prompt; trim; re-roll
clip.source: 'this scene flickers… the lights under the chairs', 'a very quick flicker of another shot'

clip.q: Is the clip soft, pixelated or low resolution?
clip.fix: 720p or higher, never 360p
clip.source: 'these always come out awfully' (360p)

clip.q: If someone speaks and there is audio: does the mouth move before or after the voice, or drift out of time?
clip.fail_if: a visible offset (skip if no speech)
clip.fix: lip-sync-dub skill: re-time the voice; cut away if it can't match
clip.source: 'She starts speaking a good second before we hear the words', 'it's drifted quite a lot'

clip.q: If someone speaks: are there smears or artefacts on the lips, do they shape different words, or is the face side-on so sync can't read?
clip.fail_if: lip artefacts or wrong words (skip if no speech)
clip.fix: face the camera more; re-roll the talking clip
clip.source: 'far too many artefacts… on the person's lips', 'the lip-syncing here is awful… we're looking at the side'

clip.q: Does the picture freeze or stop moving while the sound carries on?
clip.fix: a longer clip or a cutaway
clip.source: 'we just sort of paused it'
